name: Udyogi Ultratek 2002 Multipurpose Rescue & Fall Arrest Full Body Harness
shortDescription: Heavy-duty full body safety harness with dorsal and sternal D-rings, rescue retrieval loops, and dual-colour 44mm polyester webbing for height safety.
overview: The Udyogi Ultratek 2002 is a premium multi-application full-body fall arrest and rescue harness engineered for industrial rope access, scaffolding erection, and confined-space work. Constructed from 44mm high-tenacity virgin polyester webbing with an ultimate tensile strength exceeding 23 kN, it features distinct dual-colour webbing (bright yellow torso and black thigh straps) to ensure rapid, tangle-free donning. It is equipped with a drop-forged dorsal D-ring for fall arrest and dual sternal textile loops for ladder climbing and rescue retrieval.
keyFeatures: High-tenacity 44mm polyester webbing with high breaking strength (> 23 kN)
Dual-colour webbing scheme (Yellow/Black) prevents twisting and ensures correct donning
Forged alloy steel dorsal D-ring tested for fall arrest shock forces
Two chest sternal textile loops for rescue recovery and vertical lifeline ascenders
Fully adjustable shoulder, chest, and thigh straps with friction pass-through buckles
Comfortable sit-strap design distributes post-fall deceleration forces safely across pelvic area
Certified to EN 361:2002, EN 1497 (Rescue), and IS 3521 standards

specifications.Hardware: High Strength Drop Forged Carbon Steel (Zinc Plated)

applications: High-rise construction scaffolding and formwork assembly
Wind turbine, transmission tower, and telecom climbing
Confined space rescue operations and manhole descents
Industrial roofing, purlin fixing, and structural steel erection
